summary: I am responsible for Webel's web department: the B2C app, B2B platform, internal dashboard, SEO, email, and the shared component library.
highlights: The B2C app is used by thousands of people a day. I migrated its marketplace from Angular to React.
The B2B platform covers teams, services, calendars, leads, chat, service areas, tax details, and payouts.
I extracted the design system into a library shared by B2C, B2B, and the dashboard, and moved email to React Email.
